name: Sunken Temple Mythic: Jammal'an hexes the damage dealer, never the tank
contract: Jammal'an the Prophet 5710 is the Sunken Temple (map 109, expansion 0) encounter boss (instance_encounters 488).
His SmartAI (pending rev_20261004_90 event 3) casts Hex of Jammal'an 12479 at a random hostile player within 30
yd (target type 5, which can pick the top-threat player), first after 12 s of combat and then every 40 s; the
hex's removal transforms and charms that player (instance_sunken_temple.cpp, 12480 and 12483). Hex follows the
vanilla dungeon boss control rule (BossControlTargeting.h): it never takes a tank or healer specialization, and
it needs a second player engaged with Jammal'an, so a lone player is never hexed. Jammal'an removes his unit
flags 5 s out of combat, so the fight starts after that. The rule applies on every difficulty. On Mythic (spawn
mode 2) a Vanguard 21 tank and a Boltslinger 10 damage dealer fight him and the hex takes the damage dealer only.
The players are level 60 humans; they group in Stormwind, the tank sets Mythic through the Ascension difficulty
request, and they teleport into one instance, where Jammal'an is summoned at his own stats; player health
fixtures keep everyone alive through the window. Hex fires at 12 s and then every 40 s. When Jammal'an's own
Earthgrab Totem (8376, root 8377 every 15 s) has the target rooted at that moment, SmartAI skips the cast and its
retry is overwritten by the 40 s repeat (SmartScript::ProcessTimedAction recalculates the timer after the
action), so the window covers the second Hex.
